column3: Bayside waterfront park. Look for the hand with the bird perched on it.
South Decor District. Look for a gun sculpture pointing down at a painted mural.
Washington Beach. Three figures by the parking lot in front of the Y Hotel.
Southern Washington Beach. Look for the emoji sculpture beside the museum.
Shoeless Keys. Animal statue across Old Fort Rd from the Grassrivers Visitor Center.
Washington Beach. Stand under the Flamingo Pkwy bridge to scan Neptune.
West Frogswater. Look beside the Thrillbilly track for the figure made of tires.
Buckskin Swamp. Check behind the plaque for the pole.
Eastern Capri. Find the turkey at the center of the waterfront park.
Western Manifest Canyon. Off SR-73, find the globe on the pillar ringed by horses.
Northeast Mount Kalaga National Park. Find the hubcap dinosaur off Sassafrass Rd.
South Key Lento. Whale statue at the Sunbelt Hwy and Lemon St.
South end of Key Lento. Look for the waterside plaques and statues.
Ocean Beach. Look in the park at the island's southern tip.
Peacock Bay. Bronze rock-shaped sculpture at South Vice Ave and Marina Vista Cir.
Corsair Key. Look just offshore from the south end for the marlin.
North Gellhorn. Look for the pillar by a wooded cliff.
Southwest Lummox County. Find the memorial along Rockledge Rd.
Salton Memorial Island. Monument at the center of the island.
Downtown Vice City. Park at Catalan Blvd and Mariner's Hwy.
Northeast Millport. Wooden statue near the shipping yard on Tallaloko Lake Rd.
Tequesta. Cube-shaped fountain at South Vice Ave and Catalan Blvd.
Bayside. Scan the floating bear figures in the water by Panos Plaza.
